answer: Each epoch the ledger deals each identity a random language from twelve; its answer must be fluent in that tongue. A farm with one model in one language cannot climb that ridge: native jurors flag machine-translated text, and two flags seize the 25,000 POA bond — half burned, half to reporter — plus a 12-epoch ban. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 x 25,000 = 25,000,000 POA plus fluent text in twelve tongues per epoch; one agent pays 25,000 once. Like ivory across the tundra, fluency cannot be faked cheaply. Limitation: agents fluent in one language face a cold start on unfamiliar tongues.
